item.title: Austin Police investigate fatal shooting near Gus Garcia Recreation Center
item.description: One man is dead and another injured following a Sunday morning shooting near the Gus Garcia Recreation Center on East Rundberg Lane.

item.title: Woman rescued from one of the deepest caves in Texas
item.description: A specialized rescue team of more than 60 personnel successfully extricated a researcher from one of the deepest cave systems in Texas on Sunday morning after a falling rock caused serious head and back injuries nearly 500 feet below ground.

item.title: Texas DPS lawsuit: Jury awards nearly $1.7M to 2 state troopers
